findings.title: Dependencies not installed — install required before review
findings.explanation: The node_modules directory is missing. Turpan cannot run build, test, lint, or typecheck without first installing dependencies. Run your package manager install command before re-running the review, or pass the --install flag to have Turpan install automatically (if configured).

evidence.label: Missing node_modules
evidence.excerpt: Directory not found — node_modules is missing

findings.title: Missing test script in package.json
findings.explanation: No `test` script was detected in package.json. The test stage will be skipped without a test command.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a "test" script to package.json, e.g. "test": "vitest" or "test": "jest"

findings.title: Build script 'build' failed with exit code 127
findings.explanation: The build command exited with a non-zero exit code. This typically means a compilation error, missing dependency, or configuration issue.
findings.suggestedFix: Run the build manually to see full error: npm run build
